sermons.title: Sermon 535 | Ben-Hadad's Escape—An Encouragement For Sinners

scripture.verse: "And his servants said unto him, behold now, we have heard that the kings of the house of Israel are merciful kings: let us, I pray you, put sackcloth on our loins and ropes upon our heads and go out to the king of Israel: perhaps he will save your life. So they girded sackcloth on their loins and put ropes on their heads and came to the king of Israel and said, your servant Ben-Hadad says, I pray you, let me live. And he said, is he yet alive? He is my brother. Now the men did diligently observe whether anything would come from him and did hastily catch it: and they said, your brother Ben-Hadad. Then he said, go you, bring him. Then Ben-Hadad came forth to him. And he caused him to come up into the chariot. And Ben-Hadad said unto him, the cities, which my father took from your father, I will restore. And you shall make streets for you in Damascus, as my father made in Samaria. Then said Ahab, I will send you away with this covenant. So he made a covenant with him and sent him away."

sermons.title: Sermon 538 | Caleb—The Man For The Times

scripture.verse: "But My servant Caleb, because he had another spirit in him and has followed Me fully, him will I bring into the land he went. And his seed shall possess it."
"I charge you, O daughters of Jerusalem, if you find my Beloved, that you tell Him that I am sick of love."

sermons.title: Sermon 540 | The Lambs And Their Shepherd

scripture.verse: "He shall gather the lambs with His arm and carry them in His bosom.'"
"Standstill and see the salvation of the Lord."

sermons.title: Sermon 542 | Paul—His Cloak And His Books

scripture.verse: "The cloak that I left at Troas with Carpus, when you come, bring with you, and the books, but especially the parchments."

sermons.title: Sermon 543 | Once a Curse But Now a Blessing

scripture.verse: "And it shall come to pass, that as you were a curse among the heathen, O house of Judah and house of Israel, so will Isave you and you shall be a blessing: fear not, but let your hands be strong."
